reader.requirement: After a relative-file WRITE (any access mode), control follows VIII.1.3.5: an invalid key condition (22, 24) runs INVALID KEY if present and skips NOT INVALID KEY and the USE procedure, else runs the USE procedure and ignores NOT INVALID KEY; a non-invalid-key exception (e.g. 48) goes through the USE procedure with neither phrase; success runs NOT INVALID KEY or falls to the end of the statement; an explicit transfer inside a phrase is honoured.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError (from 2014): a random/dynamic key < 1 or above the highest RRN is '24' invalid key at 85/2002 and '34' permanent error at 2014/2023, which decides whether INVALID KEY or the USE procedure takes control
DialectLevel >= 2002 adds the SORT GR17 exit filter around a declarative call; 85 keeps the plain try/finally form; no effect on the phrase dispatch

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect over KeyedIoEmitter, SequentialIoEmitter, IoStatusClass, UseTierEmitter, DispatchEmitter, EcEmitter and Runtime/IO; the phrase dispatch itself (EmitPhrasePair over IoStatusClass) is edition-free; EC-I-O masks are zero at 85 (no TURN directive), so the plain __IoCheck hook is taken
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: a random WRITE with RELATIVE KEY 0 is invalid key 24 (INVALID KEY phrase) at 85 and permanent error 34 (USE procedure, no phrase) at 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf26_05 exercises random access OUTPUT mode with status 22 only; not 24 (boundary, sequential key overflow), dynamic access I-O mode, a non-invalid-key exception, or a GO TO inside the phrase

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR8-GR15 and VIII.1.3.5 (both arms) and the relative I-O status list (22/24/44). Read KeyedIoEmitter.EmitWrite, SequentialIoEmitter.EmitUseHook/EmitInvalid/EmitPhrasePair. Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-139/r1a.cob, runs/r1a-002; r1b.cob, runs/r1b-001), aimed at what the reader did not try: (A) a file with NO FILE STATUS and no USE, duplicate WRITE with INVALID KEY -> 'A1 OK / A2 INV / A CONTINUES' (no uncovered-fatal termination of the run unit); (F) GO TO inside NOT INVALID KEY -> 'F AT P2'; (G) a delimited WRITE nested in INVALID KEY -> 'G INNER OK / G OUTER INV TAIL', NOT INVALID KEY of the outer skipped; (B) OPEN EXTEND (1985 level-2 box) sequential relative, PIC 9 key after 8 records -> 'B1 OK 00 9' then 'B2 INV 24 9 EX10' (GR12, GR14c, GR15 record area unaffected); (C) RECORD VARYING 2 TO 6 with DEPENDING ON = 1 -> 'USE-FILE 00 44 / C1 END 44' with neither phrase (GR8, VIII.1.3.5 second arm item 1), then length 4 -> 'C2 OK 00'; (E) open-mode USE ON I-O, dynamic access, duplicate with no INVALID KEY -> 'USE-IO 22', and with NOT INVALID KEY only -> USE runs, 'E2 OK' skipped; (r1b) USE GLOBAL in the container for a GLOBAL FD written by a contained program -> 'OUTER USE 22 / C1 END 22' without the phrase, 'C2 INV 22' (global USE not run) with it, 'C3 OK 00' on success. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR8 ... the text is in GR8'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR12 ... the text is in GR12'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.1.3.5 ... it lies in GRL2.1'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.9.4 GR14 ... the text is in GR14'. Every control path of VIII.1.3.5 matched at --std 85.
